player_prompt.intro:
Tadakkest tadabakat n Sokoban. Ad teddakkel d amejjaj, emast ad tesseqdec akk tuqqatin ɣer tezziwin.
        Mi d-kkent dadda n tuqqat, tzemreḍ ad tesseqdec s tazmart n yidis.
        Ur tzemreḍ ara ad tesseqdec tuqqat ɣer yegdalen, u ur tzemreḍ ara ad ternuḍ tuqqat.
        Ɣef tebḍiert, ibuda ttun d akk: 
        - Amejjaj (kečč) itedda d 'P' 
        - Yegdalen ttun d '#' 
        - Tuqqatin ttun d 'X' 
        - Tizziwin tifessiwin ttun d 'O'
        - Tuqqatin ɣef tizziwin ttun d '√'
        Tzemreḍ daɣen ad tesseqdec [w] i ufella, [a] i tazelmaṭ, [s] i wadda, u [d] i tazelmaḍ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Aseqdec n wass ur ittam d tazmart saɛɛdit. Seqdec [up], [down], [left], [right] neɣ [w], [a], [s], [d].
